name: ragmonk_evidence
description: Grounded evidence for a question: deterministic intent routing, hard source/path/kind/document filters applied before retrieval, bounded decomposition, dedup and diversity, and typed [E#] citations re-verified against the index, with a supported / partial / insufficient_evidence verdict. Never calls an LLM or the network.

name: ragmonk_status
description: Authoritative indexing status (local SQLite or the configured OpenSearch/Elasticsearch): health and problems, live passes on every host, published counts per source, globally ordered recent errors and diagnostics. Unknown values are null, never 0. An unreachable server is an error result.

source_id.description: Only this source's row and errors (summary and problems stay global).
source_id.title: Source Id

error_limit.description: Recent errors to return (default 25, at most 200).
error_limit.title: Error Limit

StatusReport.description: The canonical RagMonk status report (schema_version 1): the same data `ragmonk status --json` prints.

relationship_state.description: The relationship graph stage, independent of index_state: the published index is searchable whatever this says.

PublishedCounts.description: Counters of the source's published (active) build only.

LiveRun.description: One source pass on this host (local) or any host (server). Remote PIDs are never shown; unknown counters are null.

ErrorEvent.description: A recorded error; the list is globally ordered by occurred_at (newest first).
